dedupe_keys.name: multilayer temporal network of public transport in great britain october 2010

description: This data set integrates timetable data from the United Kingdom open-data programme with timetables of domestic flights to give a snapshot of the temporal characteristics of the whole British public transport system for one week in October 2010. A coarse-graining procedure defines explicit couplings between modes such as connections at airports, ferry docks, rail, metro, coach and bus stations. The result is a weighted, directed, temporal and multilayer network, provided in simple, commonly used formats so that existing or new network methods can be applied directly. It was published on Dryad in December 2015. Coverage is national for Great Britain. The files, about 320 MB, are free on Dryad under CC0 1.0. Caveats: it is a single week in 2010, so services have changed since, and the coarse-graining merges nearby stops. The network supports multimodal network flow, resilience and cascading failure studies of public transport. It complements the UK NaPTAN stops, the Bus Open Data Service and the NPTDR timetable archive catalogued here.
